2607.29087.title: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds through Complementarity-Driven Iterative Collaboration
2607.29087.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings, yet individual models remain bounded by model-specific capability limitations. These heterogeneous boundaries pose a deployment challenge, but also create an opportunity: strategically coordinating multiple LLMs may unlock collective intelligence exceeding any single model. Existing approaches fix how models are combined in advance, overlooking the dynamic, state-dependent role of complementarity in complex problem solving. Drawing on the wisdom-of-crowds paradigm, we reconceptualize collective LLM intelligence as relay-style complementarity: a sequential process in which each successor model is selected to address the specific bottleneck identified in its predecessor's output. To operationalize this, we propose WILC (Wisdom Integration of LLM Crowds), a framework grounded in two design principles. First, iterative reflection-and-refinement establishes a state-preserving workflow through which models diagnose and refine prior outputs. Second, complementarity-driven model selection governs transitions via a dual-gate mechanism: prospective complementarity fit (PCF) identifies the worker most suited to the current bottleneck, while posterior complementarity gain (PCG) evaluates whether the selected transition improves the evolving solution. Experiments across four diverse benchmarks show that WILC outperforms existing approaches, including single-model self-refinement, ensemble methods, and query-routing methods. Under standardized pricing assumptions, WILC matches the average benchmark performance of GPT-5.2 at roughly 7 times lower estimated per-query cost, while facilitating data sovereignty through self-hosted deployment. This study extends wisdom-of-crowds theory from static aggregation to sequential AI complementarity and provides transferable design principles for multi-AI coordination.
2607.29087.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在企業環境中的應用越來越普遍，但個別模型仍然受到特定模型能力限制的約束。這些異質邊界帶來了部署挑戰，但也創造了一個機會：戰略性地協調多個LLM可能釋放出超越任何單一模型的集體智慧。現有的方法預先固定了模型的組合方式，忽視了在複雜問題解決中互補性的動態、狀態依賴角色。基於群眾智慧的範式，我們重新概念化集體LLM智慧為接力式互補性：一個序列過程，其中每個後繼模型被選中以解決其前任輸出中識別的特定瓶頸。為了使這一點具體化，我們提出了WILC（LLM群眾智慧整合），這是一個基於兩個設計原則的框架。首先，迭代反思與改進建立了一個狀態保持的工作流程，通過該流程模型診斷並改進先前的輸出。其次，基於互補性的模型選擇通過雙閘機制來管理過渡：前瞻性互補性適配（PCF）識別最適合當前瓶頸的工作者，而後驗互補性增益（PCG）評估所選過渡是否改善了不斷演變的解決方案。在四個不同基準上的實驗顯示，WILC的表現超過了現有的方法，包括單模型自我改進、集成方法和查詢路由方法。在標準化的定價假設下，WILC的每查詢成本估算約為GPT-5.2平均基準表現的七分之一，同時通過自我託管的部署促進數據主權。本研究將群眾智慧理論從靜態聚合擴展到序列AI互補性，並提供可轉移的多AI協調設計原則。
